# fabricext_item_access_details (Data Source)

!> **Warning:** **Experimental Provider**: The `fabricext` provider is published in a pre-`v1.0.0` experimental state to facilitate automated packaging and supply-chain verification. For core workspace and item management, use the official Microsoft [`microsoft/fabric`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/microsoft/fabric/latest) provider.

~> **Note:** For end-to-end guidance and real-world multi-persona security configurations, see the [Access Control Playbook](../guides/access_control_playbook.md).

Queries effective permissions and user access details for a Microsoft Fabric workspace item via the Admin API (`GET /v1/admin/workspaces/{workspaceId}/items/{itemId}/users`). Requires Fabric Administrator privileges or a service principal enrolled in read-only admin APIs.

## Example Usage
```terraform
data "fabricext_item_access_details" "sales_warehouse" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  item_id      = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
  type         = "Warehouse"
}

output "access_details" {
  description = "Raw principal access entries on the warehouse."
  value       = data.fabricext_item_access_details.sales_warehouse.access_details
}

output "principal_permissions" {
  description = "Lookup map from principal ID to granted permissions set."
  value       = data.fabricext_item_access_details.sales_warehouse.principal_permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) The UUID of the Microsoft Fabric item.
- `workspace_id` (String) The UUID of the Microsoft Fabric workspace.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Optional item type for route disambiguation (e.g., `Warehouse`, `Lakehouse`, `SQLDatabase`, `SQLEndpoint`, `Report`).

### Read-Only

- `access_details` (Attributes List) List of all user, group, and service principal access details returned for the item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_details))
- `principal_permissions` (Map of Set of String) Convenience map lookup keyed by principal ID (UUID), mapping to the union set of item permissions and additional permissions.

<a id="nestedatt--access_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_details`

Read-Only:

- `item_access_details` (Attributes) Permissions granted to the principal on the item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_details--item_access_details))
- `principal` (Attributes) Information regarding the principal who has access to the item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_details--principal))

<a id="nestedatt--access_details--item_access_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_details.item_access_details`

Read-Only:

- `additional_permissions` (Set of String) Workload-specific additional permissions (e.g. `ReadData`, `ReadAll`, `viewOutput`).
- `permissions` (Set of String) Standard Fabric item permissions (e.g. `Read`, `Write`, `Reshare`, `Explore`, `Execute`).
- `type` (String) Item type returned by the Admin API.


<a id="nestedatt--access_details--principal"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_details.principal`

Read-Only:

- `aad_app_id` (String) Microsoft Entra Application ID (UUID), if the principal type is `ServicePrincipal`.
- `display_name` (String) The principal's display name.
- `group_type` (String) Group type (e.g., `SecurityGroup`), if the principal type is `Group`.
- `id` (String) The principal's Microsoft Entra Object ID (UUID).
- `type` (String) The principal type (`User`, `Group`, `ServicePrincipal`, `ServicePrincipalProfile`, `EntireTenant`).
- `user_principal_name` (String) User Principal Name (UPN), if the principal type is `User`.
